text:
Samira Patel: Heads upNimbusCloud sent a partnership proposal asking for a co-badged marketplace listing + 70/30 rev share (Redwood 70) and coordinated press. They want an internal go/no-go by EOD Wed.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Can they clarify redistribution? Hosted-only vs downloadable weights? Need license text.
Samira Patel: Draft says hosted endpoints only but also includes a clause that allows them to distribute quantized weights to their SI partners.
Evelyn Chu: We need the actual license file. If redistribution of weights is allowed, eng must validate quantization artifacts and sign off on quality/regression tests.
Lina Gomez: PM needs SKU mapping across hosted/dedicated/private. Co-branding assets and a single SKU taxonomy would simplify the console UI.
Marcus Liu: Sales: break out rev share per SKU. Blanket 70/30 is too coarse. Hosted vs dedicated vs private bundle should each have negotiated splits.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Legal checklist: export controls for downloadable weights, license compatibility (no NC/ND terms), indemnity, trademark usage. Also confirm no rights to use customer data to fine-tune their upstream models.
Samira Patel: Action items: Nimbus to provide license file + brand guidelines + proposed SKU list. Internal: legal to confirm redistribution perms, eng to confirm quantization gate, product/marketing to craft announce cadence.
Evelyn Chu: Technical checklist:
```
- artifact format (gguf/pt)
- allowed quantization profiles
- runtime compatibility (inference-engine versions)
- sample perf (latency/throughput/cost)
- eval set + regression thresholds
- artifact signing/hashes
```
Lina Gomez: Marketing suggests 2 week embargo pre-announce for joint PR and a single creative point of contact. Need co-branding mockups by Tue.
Marcus Liu: Propose a clawback clause: revisit splits after 90 days if sales < target. I'll draft commercial counter with per-SKU splits + 90-day review.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Also want a clause preventing Nimbus from requiring customer data be shared or used to train their models.
marketplace-bot: partnership-docs template v1.3 available: https://redwood.internal/partner-templates.
Samira Patel: I'll ping Nimbus for the license and SKU list now. Deadline: internal feedback by Tue 17:00 PT so we can respond Wed.
__notes: Cross-functional thread: marketplace partnership, licensing, redistribution, and co-marketing coordination.
